I am growing beans on this small plot of 0.21 hectares, and since beans fix their own nitrogen, I do not see the need to buy expensive fertilizer for it. I will plant the local bean seed I saved from last season and rely on my family to manage the weeding and harvesting, which should take us a few weeks across the season. We do not have money to waste on chemicals or hired labor for legumes when our maize plot needs those inputs more.
